screen: Developer Cleanup (NavSection.developer) — currently rendered by SectionView -> CategoryResults -> CategoryDisclosure. Target: replace the generic expandable cards with a two-pane "table + right summary panel" layout, fed by store.developerBuckets.
purpose: Let a developer review every developer-group bucket (build artifacts, caches, simulators, Docker, etc.) in one scannable table with real tool icons, see a live reclaimable-space breakdown as a donut, understand WHY each row is safe, and clean selected developer junk in one action — mapping 1 row : 1 ScanStore.Bucket (group == .developer), selection driven through the existing ScanStore selection API, and cleaning routed through the existing ReviewSheet / store.clean chokepoint.
components: DeveloperCleanupView (new root, replaces SectionView for .developer): HStack — left ~65% main card, right ~35% summary panel; wrapped in the same ScrollView+padding(28) the current SectionView uses.

Header row: a '</>' icon tile (RoundedRectangle 12pt, Brand.blue.opacity(0.12) fill, SF Symbol 'chevron.left.forwardslash.chevron.right' in Brand.blue — same glyph as NavSection.developer.icon) + VStack(title 'Developer Cleanup' 22pt bold Brand.textPrimary, subtitle 13pt Brand.textSecondary 'Remove build artifacts, caches, and other developer junk safely to reclaim disk space.') + Spacer + 'Rescan' button (GhostButtonStyle, calls store.rescan()).

DevTableCard (left): single CardBackground() card containing a header strip (master 'Select All' checkbox + spacer + right-aligned column labels 'Size' and 'Safe to Delete') then a LazyVStack of DevToolRow, one per developer bucket sorted by totalSize desc.

DevToolRow: HStack — checkbox (tri-state: empty/partial/full for the bucket) + ToolIcon(28pt) + VStack(title 14pt semibold = bucket.info.title, one-line description 11pt Brand.textMuted = bucket.info.subtitle) + Spacer + size text (Fmt.size(bucket.totalSize), 13pt semibold) + SafetyPill + chevron (rotates when expanded). Tap on chevron/row expands an inline LazyVStack of the existing ItemRow for bucket.items.

SafetyPill: small capsule, green (Brand.safeCyan) 'Safe' when bucket is all-safe/regenerable; amber (Brand.amber) 'Review' when bucket contains review/quit-required items; reuses Severity color tokens. Label computed from the bucket's worst actionable severity.
ToolIcon (new): resolves the right icon per bucket/row — real app-bundle icon, real file icon, SF Symbol, or bundled brand logo (see iconStrategy).
RightSummaryPanel (right): VStack of cards — ReclaimableCard, DonutBreakdownCard, WhySafeCard, and the primary clean button.

ReclaimableCard: 'Reclaimable Space' label + big gradient number (Fmt.split on the developer total, value 34pt bold Brand.textGradient + unit) + 'Selected: <Fmt.size(selected developer total)>' in Brand.blue.

DonutBreakdownCard: a simple ring/donut (new DonutChart, a trimmed single-ring variant of DiskMapView's ArcShape) showing per-bucket share of the developer total, with a legend list (color swatch + bucket title + Fmt.size). Top ~5 buckets + an 'Other' aggregate, matching the mockup legend.

WhySafeCard: 'Why it's safe' heading + 2-4 bullet rows (SF Symbol 'checkmark.shield' / 'arrow.clockwise' / 'trash') with short reasons (regenerates on next build, moved to Trash & recoverable, never touches source code).

Primary action button: BrandButtonStyle, label 'Clean Developer Junk', subline '<Fmt.size(selected)> will be reclaimed'; disabled when selected developer size == 0; calls onReview() to open the existing ReviewSheet.
Loading/empty states: reuse CategoryResults' ProgressView 'Scanning…' and the 'Nothing to clean here' checkmark while store.isScanning / buckets empty.
dataSources: store.developerBuckets: [ScanStore.Bucket] — the row source (buckets where info.group == .developer). Current dev buckets and IDs: dev-projects (Project Build Artifacts — node_modules/target/.venv/Pods/.build), dev-caches (Developer Caches — npm/yarn/pnpm/pip/cargo/go/gradle/brew), xcode (Xcode & Simulators — DerivedData/DeviceSupport/Archives/simulators), runtimes (Language Runtimes — nvm/asdf/pyenv/conda), ide-caches (IDE & App Caches — VS Code/Cursor/JetBrains/Slack/Discord), docker (Docker), git-bloat (Git Maintenance), android (Android SDK & Emulators).
Per row: bucket.info.title, bucket.info.subtitle, bucket.info.systemImage, bucket.totalSize, bucket.selectedSize, bucket.selectedCount, bucket.actionableCount, bucket.items.

Right panel totals: developer total = store.developerBuckets.reduce(0){ $0 + $1.totalSize }; selected = reduce of selectedSize. (NOTE: store.grandTotal/selectedTotal are whole-app, not developer-scoped — compute developer-scoped sums locally.)

Selection: store.selectAllSafe(in:) / store.selectNone(in:) per bucket for row + master checkbox; store.toggle(itemID) for expanded ItemRows. RISKY/advice items are non-selectable by engine rule (toggle guards severity != .risky && isActionable).

Severity per item (ScanItem.severity: safe/review/risky) + isRegenerable + isActionable drive SafetyPill and which items the master 'Select All' may check (only safe+regenerable+actionable, via selectAllSafe).

Cleaning: onReview() -> existing ReviewSheet(store:proEnabled:) which calls store.clean(items, proEnabled:) through Cleaner; no new clean path needed.
Fmt.size / Fmt.split for all byte formatting; Brand tokens for all colors; existing DiskMapView.ArcShape for the donut geometry.

Checked/partial -> store.selectNone(in:) for every developer bucket. State derived from summed selectedCount vs total safe-selectable count across dev buckets.

iconStrategy: Four-tier resolver in a new ToolIcon view, decided PER BUCKET (table row) with a fallback chain. TIER 1 — real installed-app bundle icon via NSWorkspace for tools that ARE Mac apps: resolve the app URL with NSWorkspace.shared.urlForApplication(withBundleIdentifier:) then IconCache.icon(for: appURL). Use bucket->bundleID map: xcode -> com.apple.dt.Xcode (Xcode app icon; simulators row uses the same or com.apple.iphonesimulator); docker -> com.docker.docker (Docker whale); ide-caches -> com.microsoft.VSCode (VS Code), fall back to first item.requiresQuitBundleIDs (Cursor/JetBrains) when present; android -> com.google.android.studio if installed. This is the most authentic and self-updating. TIER 2 — real file/folder icon via existing IconCache.icon(for: item.resolvedURL) for buckets that are fundamentally folders on disk (dev-projects -> a node_modules/target folder gets the genuine macOS folder icon; git-bloat -> .git folder). Already wired through FileIcon/IconCache — reuse, do not reinvent. TIER 3 — bundled brand-logo set for tools that have NO Mac app and NO system icon: npm, yarn, pnpm, Homebrew (beer), CocoaPods (red C), Gradle (elephant), Flutter, Python/pip, conda. These power the dev-caches and runtimes rows and the finer mockup sub-rows. There is currently NO asset catalog in the project (confirmed: no .xcassets), so add one (Assets.xcassets) with template-rendered monochrome/brand PNG or PDF logos, OR draw them as small SwiftUI Canvas/Shape marks in CairnArt.swift (consistent with how CairnLogo is hand-drawn) to avoid shipping third-party trademarked raster art. Recommendation: hand-draw simple brand-tinted glyphs (beer mug, elephant, C, snake) in CairnArt to stay license-clean and theme-aware. TIER 4 — SF Symbol fallback from bucket.info.systemImage (already set: dev-projects 'folder.fill.badge.gearshape', dev-caches 'shippingbox.fill', xcode 'hammer.fill', runtimes 'cube.box.fill', ide-caches 'curlybraces.square.fill', docker 'shippingbox.fill', git-bloat 'arrow.triangle.branch', android 'smartphone') rendered in Brand.blue inside a tinted RoundedRectangle tile — guaranteed to always render. ToolIcon tries Tier 1/2 (real icon) first, then Tier 3 brand logo, then Tier 4 symbol. Always size 28pt, .interpolation(.high); cache app/file icons via the existing IconCache (extend it with an icon(forBundleID:) helper).
gaps: Row taxonomy mismatch: the mockup lists 11 fine-grained rows (Xcode Derived Data, iOS Simulators, npm/yarn/pnpm, node_modules, Docker, Homebrew, CocoaPods, Gradle, Flutter/Android, Python/pip, VS Code) but the engine exposes only 8 developer buckets. Several mockup rows live INSIDE one bucket (npm/Homebrew/CocoaPods/Gradle/pip are all items in dev-caches; node_modules & Flutter are items in dev-projects; DerivedData & Simulators are items in xcode). Decision needed: (A) one row per real bucket (8 rows, honest, least work) with the finer items shown on expand — recommended; or (B) build a synthetic row model that re-buckets items by tool (npm/Homebrew/etc.) for a 1:1 visual match, which needs a new grouping layer over bucket.items keyed on note/path. Spec assumes (A).
No developer-scoped totals on the store: store.grandTotal/selectedTotal/selectedCount are whole-app. Must compute developer-only sums in the view (no engine change required, just local reduces).

No tri-state 'select all safe across a group' helper: store has per-bucket selectAllSafe/selectNone but no group-wide call. Implement in the view by looping store.developerBuckets, or add a small store.selectAllSafe(in group:) convenience.

No simple single-ring donut component: only DiskMapView (two-ring interactive sunburst) exists. Need a trimmed DonutChart reusing ArcShape (make ArcShape non-private/shared, or copy it) — single inner ring, per-bucket color, center total, legend.
No asset catalog and no brand-logo assets exist for npm/Homebrew/CocoaPods/Gradle/Flutter/pip (Tier 3). Must add hand-drawn glyphs in CairnArt or an Assets.xcassets.

Icon authenticity for items vs buckets: a bucket-level icon needs a single representative; for dev-caches/dev-projects the most representative icon depends on which tool dominates — consider picking the icon for the largest item's tool, or just use the Tier 4 SF Symbol for these mixed buckets.

The pill must reflect the bucket's true worst severity, not always-green — a deliberate honesty deviation from the mockup.

iconStrategy: Three concrete tiers. (1) REAL app icons — the dominant case: for every app row and the summary card, use NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: appURL.path) which returns the actual bundle icon (Final Cut, Photoshop, Xcode, Steam, Sketch all resolve correctly). Wrap NSImage in a SwiftUI Image via Image(nsImage:); render at 32pt in rows, ~40pt in the summary card. Cache by appURL in a small @Observable IconCache (NSWorkspace icon lookups are cheap but do them off the hot path / memoize) and resize to 2x for crisp Retina. This same NSWorkspace.icon(forFile:) call also yields correct icons for the associated FILES/folders in the ItemDetail popover. (2) SF Symbols for ALL chrome and non-app glyphs: column-sort chevrons (chevron.up/down), checkboxes (checkmark.square.fill/square — exactly as ItemRow), the 'Safe Removal' shield (checkmark.shield / lock.shield), QUIT/badge icons, filter-chip leading glyphs (e.g. clock for Unused, cpu for Intel, doc.on.doc for Leftover, arrow.up.right.square for Large), and the nav icon (keep NavSection.apps 'a.square' or upgrade to 'trash.square'/'app.badge'). (3) Bundled brand-logo set — NOT needed for this Apps screen because every app row has a real bundle icon via NSWorkspace; the brand-logo set (npm/Homebrew/CocoaPods/Gradle, which have no NSWorkspace icon) is only relevant to the Developer/AI cache screens, so DO NOT build it here — note it as a cross-screen asset, not an Apps dependency. For the rare app whose icon fails to load, fall back to SF Symbol 'app.dashed' tinted Brand.textMuted. Developer-column text is plain text (no logo) since vendor name comes from signing info / vendor map.
gaps: BLOCKER — SafePaths chokepoint forbids the uninstaller's targets. /Users/augustusedem/CLEANSTUFF/Cairn/Core/SafePaths.swift hard-denies '/Applications' and '/Library' (denyAbsolutePrefixes) and 'Documents', and requires items be strict descendants of a scanner's allowedRoots. The current Cleaner.trash() path therefore CANNOT move an app bundle (in /Applications) or its global /Library support files to Trash. Must extend the engine: give the new scanner allowedRoots that legitimately include /Applications, ~/Applications, and the relevant ~/Library + /Library/Application Support subtrees, AND relax denyAbsolutePrefixes for the app-uninstall path specifically (e.g. a SafePaths mode/flag that allows /Applications app-bundle removal while still blocking /System and /Library/Apple-managed locations). This is a deliberate, audited change — must keep /System, Keychains, .ssh, Photos library, Mail/Messages denied.

No app-inventory scanner exists. ScannerRegistry has OrphanedAppDataScanner (leftover folders only) but nothing that enumerates installed apps as removable entities. Must build AppInventoryScanner. NavSection.apps currently maps to the 'orphaned' bucket (AppShell.swift line 50) — re-route .apps to the new screen/store.

ScanItem has no field for app metadata (developer, version, lastOpened Date, isIntel, icon). lastOpened is partially representable via latestModified but 'Last Opened' (kMDItemLastUsedDate) is semantically different from file mtime. Either add fields to a new AppEntry wrapper that GROUPS ScanItems per app, or extend ScanItem. Recommend a new AppEntry model that owns [ScanItem] for bundle+support+leftover so existing clean/undo plumbing is reused.

No grouped selection. Current ScanStore.toggle selects ONE item; the Apps page needs to toggle an app = its bundle + all associated items at once. Need AppEntry.toggle that selects/deselects the whole set.
No column-sortable table primitive exists; SectionView uses expandable disclosures, not a table. Build AppsTable from scratch (could use SwiftUI Table or a custom LazyVStack with header).
No filter-chip component exists. Build FilterChip + bar.
No 'right detail panel' layout — ReviewSheet is a modal sheet, not an inline panel. Build AppRemovalPanel as an inline column (can still reuse ReviewSheet for the final confirm).
Intel-vs-AppleSilicon detection is not implemented anywhere; need a Mach-O/arch reader.
Icon caching: NSWorkspace.icon(forFile:) returns NSImage but there's no existing IconCache; ItemRow/SectionView never render real icons today. Build a tiny cache.
Developer/vendor resolution: no signing-authority reader or vendor map exists. Need SecCode-based signer read or a bundled prefix->vendor map.

Uninstall is more destructive than cache-cleaning — needs a stronger confirm than the cache flow; the mockup's 'Safe Removal' note must be honest (moves to Trash, recoverable) and running apps must be force-quit-warned via existing RunningApps.
